summary: Numerical wording in the incidence argument, exploratory diagnostics and source-closure account matches direct integer checks and the frozen receipts. The text preserves the distinction between a diagnostic maximum of five residual candidates, a suggested total forty-five, and the accepted total eighty. checks.scope: Numerical transitions in the two-star exposition
checks.method: Read Section 3 and independently evaluated its weighted coefficients, constants and integer threshold in Python.
checks.observation: Multipliers 9 and 5 give coefficient 37 and cancel q; 9·168=1512, 37·41=1517 and floor(1512/37)=40. The stated residual-to-total transition is 40+40=80, while the boundary profile would require 41 residual members. No floor/ceiling or residual/total mismatch was found.

checks.method: Read both frozen diagnostic JSON records and checked their SHA-256 values, histograms and candidate-set count against Section 6; directly computed C(28,4).
checks.observation: Both records give 156960 geometries, the same histogram and candidate_R=20475=C(28,4). The recorded maximum five supports the wording that forty-five is suggested for two independent twenty-stars, with the missing normalization proof explicitly retained. Agreement of these outputs is not described as a Lean proof; I did not rerun either enumerator.
